qualifier: phosphatidic acid, diacylglycerol and triglyceride axis
name: Phosphatidic acid–diacylglycerol–triglyceride synthesis and lipolysis
rationale: Members cover PA/DAG/MAG/TAG synthesis, acyl remodelling, lipase activation and TAG/PC catabolism, unlike confusables centred on lysophospholipid hydrolysis, lipid droplet storage or CDP-choline PC synthesis.

name: Nucleotide catabolism and nucleoside-analogue drug metabolism
rationale: Members are pyrimidine/deoxynucleotide and NTP breakdown, NUDT sanitising and thiopurine/abacavir/ribavirin handling, whereas confusables are purine biosynthesis/salvage or nucleoside transport.

name: RAF–MEK–ERK signalling with negative feedback and ERK inactivation
rationale: Members span RAF/MEK/MAPK activation and mutants together with ERK dephosphorylation and negative feedback, which confusables (RAS GAP/SOS, positive Ras regulation, BRAF mutants) lack.

name: NAD(P) metabolism via nicotinate salvage
rationale: Members concern nicotinate metabolism, pyridine nucleotide salvage, NADP synthesis, NAD transport and catabolism, distinct from the tryptophan de novo NAD route and from CoA or adenine nucleotide confusables.

name: Regulation of epidermal wound re-epithelialization and keratinocyte migration
rationale: All members regulate epidermal spreading, epithelial/keratinocyte migration and proliferation or inflammation during wound healing, unlike confusables about suppressing adhesion/Rho signalling or VEGF signalling.

name: Iron-sulfur cluster assembly and respiratory complex III biogenesis
rationale: Members are Fe-S cluster assembly, Fe-S-dependent TCA enzyme maturation and complex III assembly, distinguishing from complex I/IV assembly, ferredoxin and heme-related confusables.

qualifier: FRS, SHC and PI3K adaptor cascades
name: FGFR downstream FRS, SHC and PI3K cascades
rationale: Members are adaptor-mediated downstream cascades of FGFR1/2/4 (and FGFR3 PI3K), lacking the ligand-binding isoform, mutant and FGFR3-centred members of confusables.

name: Glycosaminoglycan turnover and dystroglycan/Notch O-glycosylation
rationale: Members cover HS/CS/DS/KS/hyaluronan synthesis and lysosomal degradation (MPS) plus O-mannosyl, O-fucosyl and O-glucosyl glycosylation, while confusables add N-glycan, sialylation, fucose and GPI/dolichol pathways.

name: Suppression of integrin–matrix adhesion and Rac/Rho protrusive signalling
rationale: Members negatively regulate integrin signalling, cell-matrix adhesion, lamellipodia and Rho/Rac signalling and promote focal adhesion disassembly, lacking the epithelial wound-migration and CDC42/actin polymerisation members of confusables.

qualifier: apoptotic cell clearance and amyloid-beta response
name: Microglial activation and apoptotic cell clearance in neurodegeneration
rationale: Members concern microglial differentiation, activation and DAP12 signalling, efferocytosis and amyloid-beta responses, whereas confusables emphasise amyloid fibril formation and clearance.

name: NT-3–activated NTRK3 (TRKC) signalling
rationale: All members are NTF3-activated NTRK3 signalling via RAS, PI3K and PLCG1, unlike NGF/TRKA and BDNF/TRKB confusables.

qualifier: germinal centre, Tfh and plasma cell
name: Germinal centre B cell, Tfh and plasma cell responses
rationale: Members are germinal centre, memory and plasma cell signatures with Tfh differentiation and ICOS co-stimulation, unlike confusables focused on naive B signatures, B cell development/homeostasis or isotype switching.

name: Hair follicle cycling, nail and epidermal morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern anagen, hair follicle maturation, nail development and epidermis morphogenesis, unlike confusables about keratinocyte differentiation or placode and tooth development.

qualifier: growth hormone, prolactin, erythropoietin and thrombopoietin
name: Growth hormone, prolactin, erythropoietin and thrombopoietin receptor signalling
rationale: Members are hormone-like class I cytokine receptors (GH, PRL, EPO, TPO, leptin, IL-11) signalling via JAK-STAT/PI3K/RAS, distinct from IL-6-family, common-gamma-chain and FLT3 confusables.

name: Activating RAS–RAF–MAPK signalling including MRAS–SHOC2 complexes
rationale: Members are positive RAS/RAF/MAP2K/RSK and RIT/RIN signalling with MRAS–SHOC2 complexes, lacking the negative feedback, SOS and BRAF-mutant members of confusables.

name: Toxic heavy-metal response and cadmium detoxification
rationale: Members are responses to cadmium, lead, mercury, cobalt and selenium, unlike confusables centred on zinc/copper/MTF1 metallothionein and iron responses.

name: Leukotriene and pro-resolving lipid mediator biosynthesis and catabolism
rationale: Members synthesise and degrade leukotrienes, lipoxins, resolvins, protectins and maresins, lacking the receptor signalling, PAF and 12-LOX hepoxilin members of confusables.

name: Phosphorylation-dependent control of p53 and Cdc25A degradation
rationale: Members concern p53 phosphorylation, degradation and COP1 plus phospho-Cdc25A degradation, unlike confusables on AKT targets, G2/M progression and radiation checkpoints.

qualifier: oocyte spindle positioning and polar body extrusion
name: Meiosis I entry and oocyte spindle positioning
rationale: Members cover G2/MI transition, female meiosis I spindle assembly and positioning and polar body extrusion, unlike confusables on cohesion, checkpoints and male recombination/synapsis.

name: Glycogen synthesis, lysosomal glycophagy and their storage diseases
rationale: Members are glycogen synthesis, glycophagy and the GSDs of GYG1, GYS1/2, GBE1, GAA and Lafora, unlike confusables on glycogenolysis, G6PC and glucokinase.

name: Skeletal muscle myogenesis, sarcomere and neuromuscular junction organisation
rationale: Members cover myogenesis, thin/thick filament assembly, contraction, DGC and NMJ assembly, unlike confusables on SRF targets, cardiac T-tubules/junctions or calcineurin-driven adaptation.

name: Endogenous MHC class I antigen processing and proteasome assembly
rationale: Members are endogenous peptide loading onto MHC class I, cytosol-to-ER transport and proteasome assembly, unlike confusables centred on cross-presentation of exogenous antigens.

qualifier: alpha-2 suppression of catecholamine and insulin secretion
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic Gi signalling suppressing catecholamine and insulin secretion
rationale: Members are Gi/Gz-coupled alpha-2 adrenergic and adenosine signalling that inhibit adenylate cyclase and epinephrine, norepinephrine and insulin secretion, unlike cardiac, smooth muscle, cAMP/PKA and muscarinic confusables.

name: PTK6 signalling and ERBB receptor endocytic downregulation
rationale: Members are PTK6 signalling events plus ubiquitin-dependent endocytic downregulation of EGFR/ERBB and PTEN regulation, lacking the MET and ERBB adaptor-activation members of confusables.

qualifier: creatine shuttle and mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange
name: Nucleotide phosphotransfer, creatine shuttle and mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange
rationale: Members are nucleotide kinase interconversion, creatine/phosphocreatine metabolism and mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport, unlike confusables on nucleoside transport, NAD metabolism or pyrophosphate hydrolysis.
